purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public service routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits.
assessment: Longyan first-party sources establish local real-estate registration and cadastral-survey custody. The public multi-survey platform is reachable anonymously and exposes frontend CRS/configuration, but its public map routes concern land-project publicity and no safe anonymous cadastral parcel ID+geometry response was verified. No parcel sample is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound is true because the Longyan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau explicitly assigns unified real-estate registration, cadastral surveying, and registration-platform responsibilities to its Natural Resources Survey and Registration division. This does not establish an open public parcel-vector service or adapter readiness.

configurationEvidence.note: Configuration was retained in ignored scratch only; no token or credential values were used or retained. The area CRS is metadata for the platform and is not proof of a cadastral parcel layer.
